threads.body: [General] This change covers only AWS Lambda, but #11939 explicitly says to keep the issue open until GenAI and generic JMX are also covered or excluded. The `Fixes #11939` directive will therefore close the issue prematurely when this PR merges; please replace it with a non-closing reference such as `Part of #11939`, or first narrow the issue's remaining scope.

threads.body: [General] The v1.44 HTTP server convention makes `url.query` conditionally required whenever a query was received. This extractor already receives `request.getQueryStringParameters()` (and the updated wrapper test sends `a=b&c=d`), but the new v1.44 attribute set still exposes that query only inside `url.full`; `url.full` is not a substitute for `url.query`. Please emit a sanitized `URL_QUERY` using the same sensitive-parameter configuration and cover it in the query-bearing assertions.

replies.body:
Addressed in b41b44bd805394c9731b626ea6e2d98ead90b2d4.

Confirmed against the factory's explicit v1.44.0 schema and released HTTP server convention. Extract the existing encoded query once and emit URL_QUERY through UrlQuerySanitizer.redactQueryString with the same sensitiveQueryParameters used by URL_FULL. Tests verify default/configured redaction, encoding, omission for null/empty queries, wrapper a=b&c=d, and installed-agent q=value&sig=REDACTED.
